sentences.text: A writ Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 Cr.P.C and Section 528 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed on behalf of the Petitioner for issuing the directions to Respondent Nos.1 to 3 for Transfer of the Investigation of the case FIR No.95/2018 dated 16.02.2018 under Section 420/448 IPC Police Station Jaitpur, Delhi.
4. Learned APP has appeared on advance Notice and submits on instructions from the I.O that the Chargesheet is likely to be filed within four weeks.
5. Status Report be filed within fifteen days.
